expectations.text: DSL validates cleanly with the Structurizr CLI
expectations.evidence: docker validate → exit 0, but with repeated EOL warnings caused by 'theme default' pulling the cloud-service theme (service EOL 2026-09-30).

expectations.text: Model matches the spec exactly: 1 person; SPA, API, worker, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ as containers of Encurtaí; Google Workspace as external system; nothing invented
expectations.evidence: 6 containers + external Google Workspace. Added a direct usuario→api redirect relationship (reasonable reading of the redirect flow).

expectations.text: Requested views present: systemContext, container, and a dynamic redirect flow including cache lookup, miss→Postgres, and click-event publish
expectations.evidence: Views Contexto, Containers, dynamic Redirecionamento with the 4 steps (user hits API directly).

expectations.text: Styles differentiate database (cylinder), queue (pipe), and external system (distinct color)
expectations.evidence: Banco de Dados→cylinder, Fila→pipe (purple), Sistema Externo→grey; cache also cylinder (orange).

expectations.text: Modern syntax only (no enterprise/!extend/!ref/branding/theme default/dashed booleans)
expectations.evidence: Line 118: 'theme default' — removed in Structurizr DSL v6.0.0; triggers cloud-service EOL warnings on validation and will not render after 2026-09-30.

expectations.text: Relationship labels are specific and inter-process links carry technology/protocol
expectations.evidence: Labels specific with protocols (HTTPS/JSON via 'JSON/HTTPS', RESP, AMQP, SQL/TCP, OAuth 2.0/OIDC).
